decision.reason: [ev-628f9c0eccb2] says only that support for ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters and for KRaft migration was removed. It doesn't name any field, annotation or setting that marks a cluster as ZooKeeper-based or mid-migration. The proposed exposure is clearly too broad: its gvk-in-use branches for Kafka v1beta2/v1beta1 flag every environment that has any Kafka resource, including KRaft clusters that are not affected. Even the narrower spec.zookeeper branch comes from outside the evidence, and nothing here identifies an unfinished KRaft migration, so a corrected condition would need upgrade-guide or CRD evidence that names those markers.
